WHAT TO DO WITH THIS

This baseline is not the same as total household water use. Cooking, washing, infant feeding, medical devices and pets can require additional water, so plan those needs separately.

LIMITS / SAFETY

Build supplies gradually, store them safely and rotate them rather than treating preparedness as a one-off stockpile.
